description: This file defines the Polymer PaperButtonBehavior and its implementation details, including properties controlling elevation, focus management, and ripple effects, along with importing necessary dependencies.

methods.name: _calculateElevation
methods.description: Calculates and sets the elevation (shadow depth) based on focus, disabled, active, or pressed states.

methods.name: _computeKeyboardClass
methods.description: Toggles 'keyboard-focus' class based on focus source.

methods.name: _spaceKeyDownHandler
methods.description: Handles space key down events, triggering ripple down effect.

methods.name: _spaceKeyUpHandler
methods.description: Handles space key up events, triggering ripple up effect.
